text.what: The third Sunday of November in Beaune: the hospital's barrels go under the hammer, buyers pay well over the market, and the trade reads the prices as a verdict on the vintage.
text.how: Lots are barrels of new wine, sold by cuvée names that belong to the donors who gave the land. The buyer arranges the élevage and the bottling.
